title: Effect of breathwork on stress and mental health: A meta-analysis of randomised-controlled trials.

adjudication.design_quote: Effect of breathwork on stress and mental health: A meta-analysis of randomised-controlled trials.
adjudication.k_quote: Meta-analyses for secondary outcomes of self-reported/subjective anxiety ( k = 20) and depressive symptoms ( k = 18) showed similar significant effect sizes
adjudication.reason: RCT-only MA, but the review includes 12 stress RCTs plus 20 anxiety and 18 depression RCTs; the total of distinct RCTs is not stated (>=20, possibly >25), so k is not ascertainable.
